messages.subject: Spatial implementation of Dirichlet regression
parts:
Hi all,

I hope all of you are well and healthy in this pandemic situation. I am curious to know is there work on spatial modeling of compositional data with Dirichlet regression using INLA/SPDE-INLA? I read the paper arxived by Martínez-Minaya, Lindgren, López-Quílez, Simpson, and Conesa here https://arxiv.org/pdf/1907.04059.pdf; however, I couldn't find any example for spatial datasets or generally when the predictors are STAR.

Thanks in advance for your help and comments and all the best,
Hossein

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Spatial implementation of Dirichlet regression
parts:
Hi,

yes, the method in the Martínez-Minaya et al preprint is as far as we've done things practically. The method would extend to more general predictors, including SPDE models, since it's based on the combined linear predictor, but the practical implementation is more involved than we've done so far.

Finn
